pipeline_prerequisite.reason: D05-A fixture and validator are on develop; D05-B has a bounded AssetServer adapter and render harness. Runtime hardware/mobile qualification still requires actual captures.

entity_count_basis: Preset 50/200/500 counts one gameplay player+render-only actors/monsters; actual atlas body census includes one additional gameplay rival, recorded separately. Particles/background/HUD are separate.
limits: Goals are unverified until a real capture and applicable QA pass.
Render-only stress entities must never enter gameplay simulation or replay.
Low changes cosmetics and scale only; preserve boss telegraphs, HUD and combat feedback.
RAM, decoded/staging image bytes and GPU estimates are separate measurements.
Start timings cover click-play through first-controllable, including fetch/decode/GPU-upload phases even when cache hits skip work.
Dropping strong handles or despawning does not prove physical GPU memory reclamation.
No mobile conclusions from desktop, emulation or software rendering.
A 60-second sample does not establish the 600-second soak or 30 load/unload cycles.

Bevy request timeouts invalidate ownership; cancellation waits for terminal load state because public transport abort is unavailable. Permanently hung requests can keep slots occupied and require host teardown.
